descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D4 · P0 · Vikram

任务 / 用药提取规则：条件医嘱和监测医嘱要不要生成任务（UAT 和 92592 AC3 说要，prompt 故意排除）；「继续 X」要不要建 tracker 行；移植的 prompt 少了「continue X 是状态不是任务」；养老院口述用的是医院的词汇提示

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-22/S07, TC-22/S25, TC-23/S23

思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S20 「用药很多的口述：每次调用的时间和模型，以及口述的改动一个不丢（12 个药、4 处改动，两种模式）」 Medication-heavy dictation: time and model per call, and no dictated change dropped (12 drugs, 4 changes, both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U21 Each run records which model did the pre-round processing and the medication-event extraction (and the speech-to-text engine for dictation), and logs the AI call's own time separately from the total.（UAT 3.1；UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9）
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-19 Steps；UAT 3.3）
  • T9 No dictated medication or medication change is silently dropped, including in a long dictation with many drugs and several changes.（TFA-94229 R9 (Principle 2)；UAT TC-19 (the tracker shows the medications the physician dictated)；TFA-92597 What (keep the tracker current)）
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row).（UAT TC-19 ER 4；TFA-92597 R7）
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched.（UAT TC-19 ER 8；TFA-92597 R2）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The S09 and S10 fixtures plus one long pre-round dictation per mode

When Run each pre-round fixture through ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes and each encounter fixture through ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents; read diagnostics:list after the batch

Then Every call has an aiCallLog row with model, durationMs and providerMs (and fellBackFrom when Mistral answered); pre-round calls over 15 s and any call over 30 s are listed for review. In P-H and P-N every dictated drug is a row (13 each) and every change lands: apixaban held for hemoglobin, furosemide renamed to 20 with 40 kept, pantoprazole stopped, magnes …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：T9 (Pass/Fail per fixture): P-H and P-N's rowCount 13 and the four changes each. Deterministic: one log row per call with model + durationMs + providerMs (3.9, 3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). Timing is a flag, never a Fail (3.5: targets, not pass/fail): pre-round over 15 s and any call over 30 s are listed for review (flagOverMs); …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U62；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Vikram；Allure 状态按分诊从 broken 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Vikram） · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92597 ready for qa；TFA-94229 in progress

12 种药的 pre-round 口述里，只有 4 种有变化的药进了 tracker；metoprolol、atorvastatin 这类「继续」的药只出现在 Background 摘要里。

From a 12-drug pre-round dictation, only the 4 drugs with a change get tracker rows. 'Continue' meds such as metoprolol and atorvastatin appear only in the Background summary.

依据：Allure 5b9a05b0. Ledger #62 U62: 'needs Vikram/golden set'. Dev report §3 row 4: should a never-seen 'continue X' create an active row? Rest tier because TFA-94229 is in progress.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

Plan: unit U62 (#52, rest, live AI (Save Note / Save & Extract / Ask AI)) — Medication-heavy dictation: time and model. Reads diagnostics:list after each Save Note; tier 2.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #62, U62; checked: yes): Fail (rest tier) → needs Vikram/golden set — 12-drug pre-round dictation → only 4 tracker rows (the ones with events: held apixaban, stopped pantoprazole, changed furosemide, single-dose magnesium); 'continue' meds (metoprolol, atorvastatin…) only in the Background summary. Case expects 13 rows; whether a never-seen 'continue X' should create an active row is not settled by the UAT text (rule 1 is about re-dating)
